repos.description: A fast reverse proxy to help you expose a local server behind a NAT or firewall to the internet.
repos.summary_zh: frp 是一款高性能反向代理工具，专为穿透 NAT 或防火墙设计，支持 TCP、UDP、HTTP、HTTPS 协议转发，提供 P2P 连接模式。具备多协议支持、自定义域名访问内网服务、SSH 穿透、HTTP 文件服务器暴露、HTTPS 加密转发、私有服务暴露、Prometheus 监控、客户端认证等核心功能，适用于远程开发、内网服务访问、IoT 设备连接等场景。
repos.summary_en: frp is a high-performance reverse proxy designed to expose local servers behind NAT or firewalls to the internet. It supports TCP, UDP, HTTP, and HTTPS protocols, with P2P connectivity. Key features include multi-protocol forwarding, custom domain access to internal services, SSH tunneling, HTTP file server exposure, HTTPS encryption, private service exposure, Prometheus monitoring, and client authentication, ideal for remote development and IoT access.

repos.description: http下载工具，基于http代理，支持多连接分块下载
repos.summary_zh: Proxyee Down 是一款基于 HTTP 代理和 Netty 的高性能开源下载工具，支持多线程分块下载，具备扩展功能以满足特殊需求。项目因 Java 客户端开发限制暂停维护，作者计划用 Go + Flutter 重写以打造跨平台、低内存占用的下一代下载器。
repos.summary_en: Proxyee Down is an open-source, high-speed HTTP downloader built on HTTP proxy and Netty, supporting multi-threaded chunked downloads and extensible plugins. The project is paused due to Java client limitations, with plans to rewrite using Go + Flutter for cross-platform, low-memory usage.

repos.description: Share your terminal as a web application
repos.summary_zh: GoTTY 是一个将命令行工具转换为 Web 应用的轻量级工具，支持通过浏览器远程访问终端会话。它提供端口监听、TLS 加密、基础认证、随机 URL 生成等安全特性，适用于运维、开发调试和远程协作场景。
repos.summary_en: GoTTY is a lightweight CLI tool that transforms command-line tools into web-based applications, enabling remote terminal access via browsers. It supports secure features like TLS encryption, basic authentication, random URL generation, and dynamic resizing for use in operations, debugging, and remote collaboration.

repos.description: A powerful HTTP client for Dart and Flutter, which supports global settings, Interceptors, FormData, aborting and canceling a request, files uploading and downloading, requests timeout, custom adapters, etc.
repos.summary_zh: dio 是一个强大的 Dart 和 Flutter HTTP 客户端库，支持全局配置、拦截器、FormData、请求取消、文件上传下载、超时控制及自定义适配器。提供完整的 REST API 调用能力，适用于移动端和 Web 应用开发，具备高度可定制性和跨平台兼容性。
repos.summary_en: dio is a powerful HTTP client for Dart and Flutter, supporting global settings, interceptors, FormData, request cancellation, file uploads/downloads, timeouts, and custom adapters. It offers full REST API capabilities with high customization and cross-platform compatibility for mobile and web apps.

repos.description: proxychains ng (new generation) - a preloader which hooks calls to sockets in dynamically linked programs and redirects it through one or more socks/http proxies. continuation of the unmaintained proxychains project. the sf.net page is currently not updated, use releases from github release page instead.
repos.summary_zh: ProxyChains-NG 是原 proxychains 项目的现代化延续，通过 LD_PRELOAD 技术劫持动态链接程序的 socket 调用，强制流量经 SOCKS4/5 或 HTTP 代理转发。支持 Linux、BSD、macOS 等主流平台，具备 IPv6、DNAT、多线程优化等特性，适用于绕过网络限制的场景，但需谨慎使用以避免法律风险。
repos.summary_en: ProxyChains-NG is a modern successor to the original proxychains project, intercepting socket calls in dynamically linked programs via LD_PRELOAD to route traffic through SOCKS4/5 or HTTP proxies. It supports Linux, BSD, macOS, and other platforms, featuring IPv6, DNAT, and multithreading optimizations. Designed for bypassing network restrictions, it requires careful configuration and legal awareness.

repos.summary_zh: httpstat 是一个简洁高效的命令行工具，用于可视化 curl 请求的详细统计信息，包括 DNS 解析、TCP 连接、TLS 握手、HTTP 请求和响应等关键阶段耗时。它用 Python 编写，单文件无依赖，支持丰富的环境变量配置，适用于网络调试和性能分析。
repos.summary_en: httpstat is a simple yet powerful command-line tool that visualizes detailed curl request statistics, including DNS lookup, TCP handshake, TLS negotiation, and HTTP request/response timings. Written in single-file Python with zero dependencies, it offers rich customization via environment variables for network debugging and performance analysis.

repos.description: lanproxy是一个将局域网个人电脑、服务器代理到公网的内网穿透工具，支持tcp流量转发，可支持任何tcp上层协议（访问内网网站、本地支付接口调试、ssh访问、远程桌面、http代理、https代理、socks5代理...）。技术交流QQ群 736294209
repos.summary_zh: lanproxy 是一款高性能内网穿透工具，支持 TCP 流量转发，可代理访问内网网站、SSH、远程桌面等任何 TCP 上层协议。提供 Java 客户端和跨平台 Go 客户端，支持 SSL 加密、多用户管理、自定义域名绑定及 HTTPS 证书自动申请，解决公网访问内网服务的安全与便捷问题。
repos.summary_en: Lanproxy is a high-performance intranet penetration tool that supports TCP traffic forwarding for any TCP-based protocol (e.g., web access, SSH, remote desktop). It offers Java and cross-platform Go clients, with SSL encryption, multi-user support, custom domain binding, and automatic HTTPS certificate issuance, enabling secure and easy public access to private networks.

repos.description: Warcraft III Peon voice notifications (+ more!) for Claude Code, Codex, IDEs, and any AI agent. Stop babysitting your terminal. Employ a Peon today.
repos.summary_zh: peon-ping 是一款为 AI 编程助手（如 Claude Code、Cursor、Windsurf 等）提供 Warcraft III 等游戏角色语音通知的开源工具，支持多平台（macOS/Linux/Windows/WSL2）。通过语音和屏幕横幅提醒开发者任务完成或需要交互，避免终端监控中断工作流，同时支持自定义音效包和 MCP 集成。
repos.summary_en: peon-ping is an open-source tool that delivers Warcraft III and other game character voice notifications to AI coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf. It alerts users via audio and on-screen banners when tasks complete or require attention, eliminating constant terminal monitoring. Supports cross-platform use, custom sound packs, and MCP integration.

repos.description: PuTTY 中文版，原 http://code.google.com/p/puttycn 项目。
repos.summary_zh: PuTTY 是一款自由开源的跨平台 Telnet/SSH 客户端，支持 Win32 和 Unix 系统下的 xterm 终端模拟。中文版由 larryli 维护，提供本地化支持与文档翻译，适用于远程服务器管理与安全连接场景。
repos.summary_en: PuTTY is a free, open-source cross-platform Telnet/SSH client that emulates an xterm terminal on both Win32 and Unix systems. The Chinese version, maintained by larryli, offers localized documentation and support for remote server management and secure connections.

repos.description: Obfuscate all your TCP connections into HTTP protocol.
repos.summary_zh: FakeHTTP 是一款基于 Netfilter Queue 的 TCP 连接混淆工具，可将任意 TCP 流量伪装成 HTTP/HTTPS 协议，有效绕过网络审查与深度包检测。支持自定义接口、目标主机、TTL 跳数及防火墙规则配置，适用于高级网络隐蔽通信场景。
repos.summary_en: FakeHTTP is a TCP connection obfuscation tool that disguises all TCP traffic as HTTP/HTTPS protocols using Netfilter Queue. It enables stealthy network communication by bypassing deep packet inspection and censorship, with support for custom interfaces, hostnames, TTL manipulation, and firewall rule integration.

repos.summary_zh: django-socketio 是一个 BSD 许可的 Django 应用，通过集成 gevent-socketio 实现 WebSocket 支持，提供频道订阅、事件广播和信号式事件系统，支持实时通信与自动重载服务器，适用于需要实时交互的 Django 项目。
repos.summary_en: django-socketio is a BSD-licensed Django application that enables WebSocket support via gevent-socketio, offering channel-based subscriptions, event broadcasting, and a signals-like event system for real-time communication in Django projects.

repos.summary_zh: Carbon Forum HTTP API 文档为开发者提供完整的论坛接口规范，涵盖用户认证、帖子管理、通知系统等核心功能，支持分页浏览、安全验证码及头像上传，适用于构建第三方论坛客户端或集成自动化工具。
repos.summary_en: Carbon Forum HTTP API Documentation provides comprehensive interface specifications for forum operations, including user authentication, topic management, notifications, and avatar handling. It supports pagination, security codes, and is designed for building third-party clients or integrating automation tools.

repos.description: A lightweight HTTP relay that forwards /{absolute-url} requests with optional proxy and traffic dump.
repos.summary_zh: http-relay 是一个轻量级 HTTP 中继工具，支持将形如 /{absolute-url} 的请求转发至目标地址，支持代理配置与流量抓包功能，适用于调试、代理转发及流量分析场景。
repos.summary_en: http-relay is a lightweight HTTP relay tool that forwards requests in the format /{absolute-url} to target URLs, supporting proxy configuration and traffic dumping for debugging, proxying, and traffic analysis.

repos.description: Self-hostable NGINX module that serves Markdown to AI agents via HTTP content negotiation (Accept: text/markdown), powered by a Rust converter.
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个自托管的 NGINX 模块，通过 HTTP 内容协商（Accept: text/markdown）将 HTML 页面转换为 Markdown 格式供 AI 智能体读取。基于 Rust 构建，无需修改现有应用即可为浏览器返回原始 HTML，同时为支持 Markdown 的请求提供纯净内容，降低 AI 处理成本。
repos.summary_en: This project is a self-hostable NGINX module that converts HTML to Markdown via HTTP content negotiation (Accept: text/markdown) for AI agents, powered by a Rust converter. It serves clean Markdown only when requested while preserving original HTML for browsers, enabling seamless agent-friendly content delivery without application changes.
